prompt: Raise a base to a non-negative exponent using repeated multiplication in a loop. Complete the power method in the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: Exponentiation is just repeated multiplication, so a loop that multiplies an accumulator by the base exp times does the job. Starting the accumulator at 1 makes the zero-exponent case work automatically, because the loop body never runs. Declaring the accumulator as long lets results like 2^62 fit even though the inputs are ints.
hints: Start with long result = 1 and loop exactly exp times.
Each pass, multiply: result = result * base.
Starting at 1 means power(anything, 0) returns 1 without any special case.
